threads.sub: Lost two hours on a road I have driven a hundred times
threads.com:
>>42825148
Something genuinely strange happened to me last winter and I still cannot explain it.

I was driving back from my sister's place around 2am on a road I have taken a hundred times. >be me, half asleep, radio off
About twenty minutes in the road just... stopped matching my memory. The turns were in the wrong order. I pulled over and checked my phone and the GPS showed me sitting in the middle of a field.

I sat there for what felt like ten minutes. When I looked up the road was normal again and my clock had jumped forward two hours. I have never driven that route at night since and I am not sure I ever will again.
